facts.text: The user asked to refactor code that prepares notification requests.
The user said the code checks for notifications in a queue.
The user said the code sets all existing notification queue status to True.
The user said the code upserts notifications that are not created in the database.
The user said the code sets queued to True for newly added notifications.
The user said the code deactivates notifications that are not in notification_ids.
The user asked to add improvements to the code.
